description: Twelve fixed research/operations retrieval needs against a snapshot of the adopted foundation collection. Gold paths name reviewed intended sources, not exhaustive relevance judgments. No queries are changed after observing scores.

queries.question: Can a fact be used before we first observed the SEC snapshot containing it?
queries.description: The acquisition guide defines conservative observation and filing-acceptance cutoffs.

queries.question: What can we recover if this machine and its backup password are lost?
queries.description: The backup guide states that repository, restore and password share one host and off-host recovery is unproved.

queries.question: Does the ACP read-only mode actually prohibit workspace writes?
queries.description: The effective ACP sandbox is explicitly workspaceWrite despite the read-only mode identifier.

queries.question: Which cached input and reasoning counters are already included in native totals?
queries.description: The worker guide labels cached input and reasoning as subsets of input/output and forbids adding duplicate views.

queries.question: Can restarting Desktop restore exhausted native worker allowance?
queries.description: The guide separates Desktop activation from native account allowance and says restart cannot restore quota.

queries.question: What should happen before retrying an order after a connection timeout?
queries.description: The engine guide requires broker-state reconciliation before considering another submission.

queries.question: What non-credential prerequisites can block initialization of the official Alpaca adapter?
queries.description: The dependency-resolution guide retains runtime product subscription and entitlement validation.

queries.question: Does retained Dagu history prove that an interrupted workflow resumes?
queries.description: The hosting guide says completed-history persistence does not establish in-flight recovery.

queries.question: Does a gateway text response prove native tool, compaction and full-context equivalence?
queries.description: The gateway guide limits its acceptance to text and lists deferred tools, compaction and context parity as unproved.

queries.question: What independent controls are required before unattended paper execution?
queries.description: The north-star paper acceptance requires numeric limits, allowed universe and an independent kill switch.

queries.question: How do cancelled model workers avoid leaving child processes running?
queries.description: The runtime guide describes deadlines and process-group cleanup including TERM-ignoring descendants.

queries.question: Does the smaller research packet establish complete provider token savings?
queries.description: The runtime guide separates lossy selected-text measurement from unmeasured whole-task provider savings.
